landing.heroSubtitle: A calm, reliable QR attendance system for colleges, schools, coaching institutes, and teams. Works right in the browser.
landing.stepsSub: Three simple steps to move off paper registers.
landing.step1Desc: Sign up in a minute, name your roles, and get a unique organization code.
landing.step2Desc: Add people one by one, upload a CSV sheet, or let them join using your code. Each person gets a unique ID and QR.
landing.step3Desc: Open the scanner on any phone or laptop. Point at the QR card and attendance is recorded immediately.
landing.featuresSub: Everything your team needs every morning, nothing extra.
landing.feat1Desc: Continuous camera scanning with sound feedback, duplicate protection, and automatic late detection.
landing.feat2Desc: Mark people by name or ID, or mark everyone present in one tap and uncheck exceptions.
landing.feat3Desc: Daily trends, monthly register sheets, per-person percentages, and one-click CSV or PDF exports.
landing.feat4Desc: Members apply for leave in seconds. Approved dates appear automatically on calendars and reports.
landing.feat5Desc: Installable web app that adapts cleanly from small phones to desktop screens.
landing.feat6Desc: Switch the entire interface between English and Hindi anytime without reloading.
landing.whoSub: One clean hierarchy that adapts to your organization's language.
landing.whoCollegeDesc: Track lecture attendance across departments without passing sheets around.
landing.whoSchoolDesc: Fast morning roll call with instant monthly registers and parent-ready PDFs.
landing.whoCoachingDesc: Spot low-attendance students early and keep batch records organized.
landing.whoCompanyDesc: Simple check-ins with optional location checks and clean leave approvals.
landing.why1Desc: No training manual required. Clear labels, calm screens, and direct actions.
landing.why2Desc: Mark an entire class or team in under a minute with continuous QR scanning.
landing.why3Desc: Strict organization isolation. People only see the records they are permitted to see.
landing.faq1A: Yes. You can create your organization, add your team, and mark attendance right away at no cost.
landing.faq2Q: Do members need to install an app?
landing.faq2A: No. They can open it in any browser, save their QR image, or print an ID card. They can also install it to their home screen if they like.
landing.faq3Q: How is the QR code made?
landing.faq3A: As soon as someone is added or approved, a unique ID and QR code are generated automatically for them.
landing.faq4Q: Can one person see another person's data?
landing.faq4A: No. Members only see their own records. Managers only see their own assigned members. Organizations are completely isolated from each other.
landing.faq5A: Yes. It is designed mobile-first so you can scan QR codes directly using your phone's back or front camera.
landing.contactSub: Questions or feedback? Send us a short message.
landing.contactSent: Thank you. Your message has been sent.
landing.footerTagline: Calm QR attendance for everyday organizations.
